description: Check and edit the translation files of edu-sharing (Angular JSON, metadatasets, mail templates) in a table or list, with undo and backups.
view.areas.noFolder:
Open a folder with edu-sharing translations: an edu-sharing checkout, or its translation folder (Frontend/src/assets/i18n) or a copy of it.
[Open Folder](command:vscode.openFolder)

untrusted.description: In Restricted Mode, translations can only be viewed and checked; writing files is disabled, and the workspace settings for areas, variants and roots are ignored.
config.title: edu-sharing i18n
config.referenceLanguage: Language that translations are compared with. `de` also matches `de_DE`.
config.baseFileLanguage: Language of files without a locale suffix, such as `templates.xml` or `mds.properties`.
config.areas: Additional translation areas, or the replacement of a built-in area with the same `id`. Example: `{ "id": "customer", "format": "json-nested", "roots": ["customer/i18n"], "files": "{bundle}/{locale}.json", "localePattern": "[a-z]{2}" }`.
config.roots: Fixed root folders per area id, relative to the workspace folder. Areas without an entry are detected automatically.
config.exclude: Glob patterns of folders that are never searched for translation files.
config.variants: Sparse language variants. `base` is the locale a variant falls back to, `requiredWhen` a regular expression for base texts that need an own variant text, `forbidden` text the variant should not contain.
config.checks.ignoreSameAsReference: Texts that may be identical to the reference without being reported.
config.diagnostics.missing: How missing keys appear in the Problems panel.
config.diagnostics.missing.aggregate: One problem per file with the number of missing keys
config.diagnostics.missing.off: Not shown in the Problems panel
config.backup.intervalMinutes: Minutes after which the next change backs up the translation files again. `0` turns this off; the backups before the first change of a session and before changes of several bundles still happen.
config.backup.keep: Number of backups to keep. Backups lie in the extension's storage for this workspace, never in the repository.
config.areas.id: Unique id of the area; a built-in area with the same id is replaced.
config.areas.label: Name of the area in the views; default: the id.
config.areas.roots: Root folders of the area, relative to the workspace folder; not needed with `detect`.
config.areas.files: Path of the files below a root, with `{bundle}` and `{locale}`; `[…]` marks an optional part, e.g. `{bundle}/{locale}.json`.
config.areas.localePattern: Regular expression for `{locale}`, without anchors, e.g. `[a-z]{2}(-[a-z0-9]+)*`.
config.areas.bundlePattern: Regular expression for `{bundle}`; default: one path segment.
config.areas.bundleName: Bundle name of files without a bundle part.
config.areas.referenceLanguage: Reference language of this area; default: `eduI18n.referenceLanguage`.
config.areas.bundleOrder: Order in which the application loads the bundles; with `mergeSemantics`, later bundles override earlier ones.
config.areas.mergeSemantics: How the application merges the bundles: `shallow-toplevel` replaces whole top-level values and turns on the checks `key-overridden` and `subtree-lost`.
config.areas.detect: How the roots are found: marker files in the workspace folder and their path below the root.
config.areas.detect.glob: Glob that finds the marker files, e.g. `**/common/de.json`.
config.areas.detect.marker: Path of a marker below its root, e.g. `common/de.json`; the glob must end with it.
config.areas.ignoredKeys: Keys that are no translations, e.g. a guard line: the extension hides them and keeps them in the files.
config.areas.placeholderSyntax: How the texts write placeholders: `double-brace` for `{{name}}` (default, Angular and mail templates), `single-brace` for `{name}` (metadatasets).
config.areas.overrideBundlePattern: Regular expression for the names of bundles that override others at runtime, e.g. `.+_override`: they hold only what they change, so the extension reports no missing keys or files for them.
config.variants.base: Locale the variant falls back to, e.g. `de`.
config.variants.requiredWhen: Regular expression: when it matches the base text, the variant needs its own text.
config.variants.forbidden: Regular expression for text the variant should not contain.
config.rule.non-string-value: A value is not a text, e.g. a number or a list.
config.rule.duplicate-key: A key occurs twice in the same file; only one definition counts.
config.rule.not-utf8: A file is not valid UTF-8.
config.rule.bom-first-key: The first key of a .properties file with a byte order mark, which Java never finds.
config.rule.missing-file: A bundle has no file for a language.
config.rule.missing-key: A key of the reference is missing in a language; the fallback text appears.
config.rule.empty-value: A text is empty although the reference has one; it hides the fallback.
config.rule.orphan-key: A key exists in a language but not in the reference.
config.rule.misplaced-key: An orphan key whose last segment matches a missing key: probably in the wrong place.
config.rule.placeholder-malformed: A placeholder is written wrongly, e.g. `{{{x}}`.
config.rule.placeholder-mismatch: The placeholders differ from the reference.
config.rule.html-mismatch: The HTML tags differ from the reference.
config.rule.variant-needed: The base text needs a text of its own in a variant, e.g. the formal address for `de-informal`.
config.rule.variant-inconsistent: A variant's text contains what it should not, e.g. the formal address in `de-informal`.
config.rule.variant-orphan: A variant has a key that its base does not have.
config.rule.key-overridden: A top-level key occurs in several bundles with another text; the later bundle wins.
config.rule.subtree-lost: A top-level object occurs in several bundles; the keys of the earlier ones are lost at runtime.
config.rule.same-as-reference: A text is the same as the reference and may be untranslated.
config.rule.lost-character: A question mark between letters or a replacement character: a character lost when the file was saved in another encoding.
